notes.title: Dev Update 🌱 A New Game is Here!
notes.content:
[h2]Dev Update 🌱 A New Game is Here![/h2][p]Hello everyone, I’m the developer of [i]Shanshui Haven[/i].
First of all, thank you so much for all the support and feedback you’ve given to this game 🙏
Today I’d like to share some exciting news: my new game [b]Relaxing Farm: Merge Tales[/b] is now live! 🎉[/p][p]It’s a relaxing [b]card-based farm merging game[/b] where you can:[/p][list][*][p]🌱 Drag & merge cards to grow crops, raise animals, and cook delicious food[/p][/*][*][p]💰 Sell products or combine them into higher-value goods for greater profit[/p][/*][*][p]📦 Complete customer orders to unlock new crops, animals, and buildings[/p][/*][*][p]🌊 Face exciting “Order Wave” challenges with limited-time goals[/p][/*][*][p]🏡 Enjoy a cozy art style and easy-to-pick-up gameplay that’s both relaxing and rewarding[/p][/*][/list][p]If you enjoyed the calm and cozy atmosphere of [i]Shanshui Haven[/i], you might also find this new game a fun experience.
Feel free to check it out and add it to your wishlist! 💖[/p][p]👉 \[[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3733620/_/"]Relaxing Farm: Merge Tales[/url]][/p]

notes.title: Shanshui Haven Full Version is Now Live
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44710367/9667902745d4ab17b3bdc49b45e277c48dd97fae.png[/img]

[h2]Dear Players,

I am thrilled to announce that the full version of Shanshui Haven is officially released today! I sincerely thank all the players for their support and feedback during the Early Access phase. I've worked hard to refine the game to an ideal state, and I hope everyone can enjoy the relaxation and fun this game offers amidst their busy schedules.[/h2]

[b]Changes from the previous version:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added more building shapes[/b]: Enhances the fun and challenge of the game.
[*] [b]Adjusted some visual effects[/b]: Makes the game more visually appealing.
[*] [b]Optimized the values of special function cards[/b]: Balances the game better.
[*] [b]Adjusted the drop rates and scores of rare buildings[/b]: Adds strategic depth to the game.
[/list]

[b]Future Plans:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New game project[/b]: After a short break, I will start a new game project. Stay tuned for updates.
[*] [b]Continuous updates for Shanshui Haven[/b]: Although the update frequency will decrease, I will continue to update Shanshui Haven. If you have any interesting ideas and suggestions, please leave them in the comments. I will see them. For changes that do not affect the overall game structure, I will consider adding them in future updates.
[/list]

[h3]Thank You:

Once again, thank you to all the players who participated in the Early Access testing and to the hundreds of players who purchased the game during the Early Access phase. Your support and encouragement have motivated me to continually improve and officially release this game. Wishing everyone a happy life![/h3]

notes.title: Four-Tile Building Coverage!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44710367/cfe5066e128482091e68c6a67c53daa03d4913b6.png[/img]

[h2]Dear Players,

We are excited to continue bringing you new game features and improvements! Here are the details of this update:[/h2]

[b]New Features and Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Four-Tile Building Coverage[/b]: Four-tile buildings can now cover some resource plots such as trees, bushes, and animals (excluding mountains), adding more strategic options.
[*] [b]Valid Value Range Checks[/b]: Added checks for the rational placement of buildings to ensure each placement falls within a reasonable value range.
[*] [b]Immediate Access to Unlocked Buildings[/b]: Players can now immediately access buildings upon unlocking them, enhancing game fluidity and interaction.
[*] [b]Complete Building List and Harvest Upgrades[/b]: Added a complete list of buildings detailing how to enhance their harvest efficiency and functionality through upgrades.
[*] [b]Adjustments to Building PlaceScore[/b]: Adjusted the PlaceScore of buildings, with later-appearing buildings scoring higher, motivating players to stay active in later game stages.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes[/b]: Several critical bugs have been fixed, including:
- Fixed occasions where scores could become negative, ensuring the stability of the scoring system.
- Fixed issues where no cards were dropped upon harvesting, ensuring proper reward distribution.
- Fixed the issue where building scores were not updated after upgrades, ensuring score reflections post-upgrade.
- Removed upgrades from grass and stone terrains to maintain game balance.
- When the building selection UI pops up, the range of the next building will no longer be displayed, making the display clearer.
[/list]

[h3]We hope you enjoy these new features and look forward to your valuable feedback. Thank you for your continued support and passion![/h3]

notes.title: Building Info, Enhanced Graphics, and Richer Gameplay
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44710367/529f5eddeeb213d4575ce0938e883aca07032c86.png[/img]

[h2]Dear Players,

Following our last update, we have continued our efforts to enhance the visual appeal and interactivity of our game. We are excited to announce that a new update is now live! Here are the highlights of this update:[/h2]

[b]New Features and Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]ESC Key Support[/b]: You can now use the ESC key to quickly exit game menus and interfaces, improving the convenience of the game.
[*] [b]Building Information Display[/b]: When players hover the mouse over the current building card, specific values for Buffs and Debuffs are displayed, aiding in decision-making.

[*] [b]Environmental Fog Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug that caused environmental fog not to be destroyed properly, improving the game's performance and visual quality.
[*] [b]Updated Shapes for Farms and Residential Houses[/b]: More shapes for farms and residential houses have been added, enriching the architectural diversity of the game.
[*] [b]Artistic Resource Update[/b]: Updated the artistic resources for herds, gold mines, and iron mines, enhancing the visual appeal of these elements.
[*] [b]Updated Bird VFX[/b]: Updated the visual effects for birds, making them appear more lively and realistic.
[/list]

[list]
[*] We believe these updates will provide you with a more beautiful, smooth, and immersive gaming experience. We look forward to your feedback and will continue to work hard to improve the quality of the game and player satisfaction.
[/list]

notes.title: Hi Everyone, Welcome to Shanshui Haven
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44710367/bdf09421ff8f1b2e6f889a35cb039b4e4b261f64.png[/img]
[h2]Hi Gamers,

My new game, "Shanshui Haven," is now available on Steam! It's a serene and picturesque city-building game, perfect for players who enjoy strategy and desire a peaceful atmosphere. The game now features three modes, each offering a unique gaming experience![/h2]

[b]Casual Mode:[/b] For those who want to relax and enjoy the game at their own pace, without the pressure of competition, Casual Mode is for you. Here, you can play leisurely, enjoying a stress-free gaming environment.

[b]Challenge Mode:[/b] For players seeking to improve their skills and enjoy the thrill of a challenge, Challenge Mode will offer increased difficulty and excitement. Get ready to test your strategies and reflexes!

[b]Free Build:[/b] Unleash your creativity! In this mode, there are no rules, no limits. You are free to create and build anything you can imagine. It's the ultimate sandbox experience where your imagination is the only boundary.

We can't wait to see your creations and achievements in these new modes. Thank you for your continued support and love for our game, and we hope you enjoy this update!
